MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (sp:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (src:Section {sectionNumber:'5.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp)
MATCH (src)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(mid:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(end:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT end.sectionId AS sectionId
